newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish farmers want compensation for truck strike.
newsitem.headline: Spanish farmers want compensation for truck strike.

text.p: Spain's farmers are demanding financial compensation from the government to help lessen the blow of the French truckers strike on their produce, a farmer's association said on Friday.

The Confederation of Spanish Agricultural Cooperatives (CCAE) said the truck drivers' blockade of 230 of France's main roads and almost half the country's petrol depots had led to losses of 45 billion pesetas for Spain's fruit and vegetable exporters.

"Spain's fruit and vegetable export sector makes 25 percent of its total business in this period and so the economic consequences could get even worse if this situation persists," the CCAE said in a statement.
The association said farmers were suffering as their fruit and vegetable crops lay redundant and harvesting, packaging and distribution work remained frozen.

"The confederation is demanding a package of fiscal and financial help to alleviate the effects of the striking French truck drivers on the agriculture sector," the CCAE said. --Madrid newsroom + 34 1 585 2161
